description: This file defines the Graph class in TensorFlow's Java API, representing a data flow graph for computations, including methods for graph manipulation, resource management, and gradient computation.

classes.name: Graph.Reference
classes.description: Inner class to manage native handle references and ensure proper resource cleanup with reference counting.

classes.name: Graph.OperationIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing all operations in the graph.

classes.name: Graph.WhileSubgraphBuilder
classes.description: Interface to build subgraphs for while loop conditions and bodies.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the Graph, waiting until no active Sessions refer to it.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Returns the operation node with the specified name, or null if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: operations
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all operations in the graph.

methods.name: opBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder to add operations of a specified type and name.

methods.name: importGraphDef
methods.description: Imports a serialized GraphDef into this graph, with optional name prefix.

methods.name: toGraphDef
methods.description: Serializes the current graph into a byte array representation.

methods.name: addGradients
methods.description: Adds gradient operations to compute derivatives of outputs y w.r.t. inputs x.

methods.name: addGradients (overload)
methods.description: Simplified gradient computation for a single output y and inputs x.

methods.name: whileLoop
methods.description: Creates a while loop in the graph with specified condition and body subgraph builders.

methods.name: ref
methods.description: Creates a new Reference object to manage native handle lifecycle.

calls: whileLoop(nativeHandle, inputHandles, inputIndices, name, cgBuilder, bgBuilder)
